stickman_art._route_note: Google Flow (Flow Queue - Auto Veo & Nano Banana extension) and Meta AI are browser surfaces with no API this pipeline can reach. The prompt builder emits a numbered, timestamped manual handoff sheet; a human runs the queue and drops the returned files into the episode's assets directory. Nothing here submits automatically.
